description_en: A U-shaped sectional with two facing short returns and one continuous rear seating run; the front opens into the central seating cavity, the side shows one return in profile, and the rear reveals a long reinforced woven wall with two corner joints. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
